name: @royco/access-subgraph
description: Goldsky subgraph indexing Royco's OZ AccessManager + Concrete vault AccessControl

scripts.prepare:mainnet: npm run render:mainnet && npm run codegen && npm run build
scripts.deploy:mainnet: npm run render:mainnet && npm run codegen && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-mainnet/0.1.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:avalanche: npm run render:avalanche && npm run codegen && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-avalanche/0.1.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:arbitrum: npm run render:arbitrum && npm run codegen && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-arbitrum/0.1.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:base: npm run render:base && npm run codegen && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-base/0.1.0 --path .
